all_candidates.topic: Should celebrities be held more accountable for surrogate ads?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Maharashtra FDA recently issued notices to Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff over the Vimal Elaichi ad for alleged surrogate promotion (Aug 16, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should NEET/JEE be replaced by new admission models?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The NEP Review Committee Chairman recently stated that NEET, JEE, and CUET exams may see changes under new admission models for higher education (Aug 16, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Does India need to completely redesign its exam system?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Following the NEET paper leak controversy, there are calls to completely reset India's fragile examination system (Aug 12, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should states regain full control over college admissions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Omar Abdullah recently questioned the centralized NEET and JEE exams, arguing they eroded states' rights over admissions (Aug 15, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is the NTA effectively ensuring transparency in national exams?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The National Testing Agency (NTA) recently released provisional answer keys for UGC-NET June 2026, with a challenge window open until August 18 (undated, but listed in Aug 16, 2026 news).

all_candidates.topic: Should hygiene standards in food outlets be more strictly enforced?

all_candidates.topic: Should airports enhance security for licensed firearm holders?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A passenger's licensed pistol accidentally discharged at Varanasi airport, injuring two security staffers (Aug 16, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should government strictly regulate misleading discounts post-GST cuts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Consumer Affairs Ministry is closely monitoring misleading discount practices by retailers after previous GST rate reductions (undated, but discussed in recent consumer news).

all_candidates.topic: Should e-commerce platforms face stricter penalties for complaints?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Nearly 20 lakh consumer complaints were lodged against e-commerce platforms over the last five years, with annual grievances doubling (Aug 14, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are India's consumer forums failing to deliver timely justice?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court recently flagged the slow handling of cases in consumer forums, calling for an urgent performance review (Aug 14, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is AI creating more jobs than it eliminates in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report indicated that AI is currently creating more jobs than it is eliminating in India, adding 83,100 AI-related jobs versus 31,921 lost (Aug 7 & 11, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is AI causing a decline in entry-level IT job hiring in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report indicated that while AI creates jobs, entry-level hiring in India's IT sector is declining as AI takes over routine tasks (Aug 11, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will Delhi's new EV policy successfully boost electric vehicle adoption?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi's new EV Policy, effective July 1, 2026, introduces mandatory deadlines for electric three-wheelers and two-wheelers registration from 2027-2028 (Aug 14, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should companies face penalties for long onboarding delays?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An IT rights body recently wrote to the Labour Ministry regarding significant onboarding delays by a major IT firm (undated, in news from Aug 16, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 petrol be mandatory for all vehicles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government recently defended its E20 petrol policy, stating it saved consumers nearly ₹30 per litre during crude price spikes and reiterated no plans for ethanol-free variants (Aug 1, 2026; ongoing debate).

all_candidates.topic: Should India prioritize a green economy over rapid industrial growth?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently unveiled the 'Saptadhara' framework, emphasizing a green and blue economy for Viksit Bharat by 2047 (Aug 15, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is allowing secondary UPI users a good security move?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI recently introduced a feature allowing primary users to authorize secondary users for UPI transactions from their bank accounts (Aug 13, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are AI/ML professionals overestimating layoff risks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A recent survey found that 66% of AI and Machine Learning professionals in India expect layoffs or significant headcount reductions within the next 3-6 months (Aug 10, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is the new ₹5 lakh UPI tax payment limit beneficial?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI recently increased the UPI transaction limit for tax payments from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh per transaction (Aug 13, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will GST administrative overhaul truly benefit taxpayers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Indian government has prepared plans for a sweeping overhaul of the country's tax administration structure to ensure a glitch-free GST rollout (Aug 8, 2026).
